description: Comparison of actin nucleotide-cleft and catalytic positions in ACTR5, Arp4 and Arp8, with ARP5 orthologue conservation
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches

rows=[  # (actin pos+aa, role, ACTR5, ARP4y, ARP8h, class)
 ("D11","Mg2+ ligand / P1","D36","D20","H52"),
 ("G13","P1 loop","G38","G22","G54"),
 ("S14","alpha-phosphate","S39","S23","S55"),
 ("G15","P1 loop","F40","Y24","T56"),
 ("M16","P1 loop","Q41","T25","T57"),
 ("K18","beta/gamma-phosphate","R43","N27","R59"),
 ("Q137","CATALYTIC: orients W1","D166*","T142","E266"),
 ("D154","Mg2+ ligand / P2","S187","D159","D283"),
 ("G156","P2 loop","G189","G161","G285"),
 ("D157","P2 loop","Y190","H162","D286"),
 ("H161","CATALYTIC: activates W1","H194","S166","S290"),
 ("G182","phosphate clamp","G215","G187","G311"),
 ("E214","phosphate clamp","H247","gap","E348"),
 ("G301","adenine pocket","G495","G412","G539"),
 ("G302","adenine pocket","G496","G413","G540"),
 ("T303","adenine pocket","N497","T414","G541"),
 ("M305","adenine pocket","M499","S416","M543"),
 ("Y306","adenine pocket","Y500","I417","F544"),
]
cols=["ACTR5 (human)","Arp4 (yeast)","Arp8 (human)"]
def same(actin, other):
    if other=="gap": return 2
    a=actin[0]; b=other[0]
    if a==b: return 0
    groups=[set("KR"),set("DE"),set("ST"),set("NQ"),set("ILVM"),set("FYW")]
    for g in groups:
        if a in g and b in g: return 1
    return 2
M=np.array([[same(r[0],r[2+j]) for j in range(3)] for r in rows])

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(14.5,7.6), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.45,1]})
palette={0:"#2b6b4f",1:"#c9a227",2:"#b3412c"}
ax=axes[0]
for i,r in enumerate(rows):
    for j in range(3):
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((j,len(rows)-1-i),1,1,facecolor=palette[M[i,j]],edgecolor="white",lw=1.5))
        ax.text(j+0.5,len(rows)-1-i+0.5, r[2+j], ha="center",va="center",color="white",fontsize=10,fontweight="bold")
ax.set_xlim(0,3); ax.set_ylim(0,len(rows))
ax.set_xticks([x+0.5 for x in range(3)]); ax.set_xticklabels(cols, fontsize=11)
ax.set_yticks([len(rows)-1-i+0.5 for i in range(len(rows))])
ax.set_yticklabels([f"{r[0]}  {r[1]}" for r in rows], fontsize=9.5)
ax.xaxis.set_ticks_position("top"); ax.xaxis.set_label_position("top")
for s in ax.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)
ax.tick_params(length=0)
ax.set_title("Actin nucleotide-cleft positions mapped onto nuclear Arps\n"
             "by structural superposition (nucleotide frame + ICP on Calpha)",
             fontsize=12, pad=34, loc="left")
for i,r in enumerate(rows):
    if "CATALYTIC" in r[1]:
        ax.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((0,len(rows)-1-i),3,1,fill=False,edgecolor="black",lw=2.2))
hs=[mpatches.Patch(color=palette[0],label="identical"),mpatches.Patch(color=palette[1],label="conservative"),
    mpatches.Patch(color=palette[2],label="non-conservative / absent")]
ax.legend(handles=hs, loc="lower center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5,-0.11), ncol=3, frameon=False, fontsize=9.5)

# right panel: ARP5 ortholog conservation
orth=pd.read_csv("arp5_ortholog_conservation.csv")
keep=orth[orth.ACTR5_human.isin(["D36","G38","S39","R43","D166","S187","G189","Y190","H194","G215","G495","G496","M499","Y500"])]
ax2=axes[1]
names=["ACTR5_human","ACTR5_mouse","ARP5_drome","ARP5_yeast"]
lab=["human","mouse","Drosophila","S. cerevisiae"]
K=len(keep)
for i,(_,row) in enumerate(keep.iterrows()):
    vals=[row["ACTR5_human"][0]]+[row[n] for n in names[1:]]
    for j,v in enumerate(vals):
        ok = (v==vals[0])
        ax2.add_patch(plt.Rectangle((j,K-1-i),1,1,facecolor="#2b6b4f" if ok else "#b3412c",edgecolor="white",lw=1.5))
        ax2.text(j+0.5,K-1-i+0.5,v,ha="center",va="center",color="white",fontsize=10,fontweight="bold")
ax2.set_xlim(0,4); ax2.set_ylim(0,K)
ax2.set_xticks([x+0.5 for x in range(4)]); ax2.set_xticklabels(lab, fontsize=10, rotation=20, ha="left")
ax2.set_yticks([K-1-i+0.5 for i in range(K)])
ax2.set_yticklabels(list(keep.ACTR5_human), fontsize=9.5)
ax2.xaxis.set_ticks_position("top"); ax2.xaxis.set_label_position("top")
for s in ax2.spines.values(): s.set_visible(False)
ax2.tick_params(length=0)
ax2.set_title("ARP5 orthologue conservation at the same positions\n(global pairwise alignment to human ACTR5)",
              fontsize=12, pad=34, loc="left")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
